name: org.uavocab/uavocab
title: UA Vocab: Ukrainian Frequency
description: Ukrainian word stress, validated CEFR levels, lemmatizer and text-level profiler for learners.

tools.name: lookup_word
tools.description: Any form of a Ukrainian word (an inflected form lands on its lemma): where the stress falls, its validated CEFR level, its frequency rank in modern Ukrainian, an English gloss, open pronunciation audio and dictionary definitions. One word at a time.

word.description: A Ukrainian word in any form, for example операцію or читали

tools.name: lemmatize
tools.description: Ukrainian text to its lemmas, by the same convention as the frequency list's headwords (LanguageTool's Ukrainian analysis over the VESUM dictionary), with each token's part of speech and its offsets in the text. Up to 10,000 characters.

text.description: Ukrainian text, a word to a few paragraphs

tools.name: profile_text
tools.description: How much of a Ukrainian text a learner at each CEFR level already knows, as running-text coverage against the validated level word sets, and for one level: whether it clears the 95 or 98 percent reading threshold, the words above that level, and where a word family or an aspect pair may mislead. Names are left out of the count. Up to 20,000 characters.

level.description: The learner's level, for the verdict and the word list. Default B1.

threshold.description: The coverage a comfortable read needs, 95 or 98 percent. Default 95.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Every dataset the Ukrainian Frequency study publishes: its license, its archive DOI (concept and latest version), whether it is held back and why, and where the files, the open repository and the Python package are.
